name: ScanObjectNN: Real-World 3D Object Classification Benchmark
description: ScanObjectNN is an established real-world 3D object classification benchmark generated from 3D indoor scene scans (SceneCAD and ScanNet). Unlike synthetic CAD models, ScanObjectNN contains 2,902 unique object instances across 15 common categories afflicted with real-world sensor scanning artifacts including severe occlusions, sensor noise, non-uniform point densities, and complex background geometry, providing a rigorous testbed for 3D point cloud classifiers.
